payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to develop per-triple templates, including hand-crafted templates and transformations of triples into facts.

claims.text: Per-triple templates were developed using hand-crafted templates for each predicate, transforming triples into facts.
The transformation of triples into facts serves to introduce in-domain knowledge about the semantics of individual predicates.
Templates were created manually for all predicates in the datasets used, including unseen predicates in the test set.
